# DigitalOcean

> > DigitalOcean is an AI-powered unified cloud infrastructure platform offering scalable compute, managed databases, Kubernetes, serverless functions, and Gradient AI for optimized AI/ML workload deployment.

DigitalOcean provides developers and enterprises with accessible cloud infrastructure services ranging from virtual machines (Droplets) to managed Kubernetes clusters, databases, and its flagship Gradient AI platform for agentic inference. The platform emphasizes simplicity, affordability, and integrated AI capabilities across its product ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Gradient AI
- Droplets
- Managed Kubernetes
- App Platform
- GPU Droplets
- Managed Databases
- Serverless Functions
- Cloud Infrastructure
- AI Inference
- High-Performance Computing
- Auto-scaling
- Bare Metal GPUs
- Cloudways
- API
- Disaster Recovery

## Core Cloud Infrastructure

- [DigitalOcean: AI-Powered Unified Inference Cloud Infrastructure](https://www.digitalocean.com): DigitalOcean homepage: AI cloud infrastructure with Gradient AI platform.
- [DigitalOcean Droplets | Scalable Cloud Compute Starting at $4/mo](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/droplets): DigitalOcean Droplets: scalable virtual machines with flexible configurations.
- [Droplets | DigitalOcean's Scalable Virtual Machines](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/droplets/cpu-optimized): CPU-Optimized Droplets for high-performance analytics and media streaming.
- [DigitalOcean Managed Kubernetes | Starting at $12/mo.](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/kubernetes): DigitalOcean Managed Kubernetes with free control plane and auto-scaling.
- [DigitalOcean App Platform | Build, Deploy, and Scale Apps with Ease](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/app-platform): App Platform: deploy and scale apps from code to production in clicks.
- [DigitalOcean Functions | Serverless Computing Starting at $0/mo](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/functions): DigitalOcean Functions: serverless computing with auto-scaling.

## Gradient AI & GPU Infrastructure

- [Gradient AI Agentic Inference Cloud | DigitalOcean](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/gradient): Gradient AI: agentic inference cloud for optimized AI workload deployment.
- [Gradient™ AI Platform | Build AI Agents with DigitalOcean](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/gradient/platform): Gradient Platform: serverless AI agents with LLM access and RAG.
- [Gradient™ AI GPU Droplets | DigitalOcean](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/gradient/gpu-droplets): Gradient GPU Droplets with NVIDIA and AMD for AI/ML acceleration.
- [Gradient™ AI Bare Metal GPUs for AI/ML Workloads | DigitalOcean](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/gradient/bare-metal-gpus): Bare Metal GPUs with NVIDIA H100/H200 and AMD MI300X for AI.
- [1-Click Models - Gradient™ AI | DigitalOcean](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/gradient/1-click-models): Deploy AI models with one-click on Gradient GPU infrastructure.

## Data & Database Services

- [Worry-Free Managed Database Hosting | DigitalOcean](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/managed-databases): DigitalOcean Managed Databases with auto-scaling, backup, and failover.
- [DigitalOcean Backups](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/backups): DigitalOcean Backups: automated disaster recovery and data protection.

## Managed Hosting & Platforms

- [Fully Managed VPS Hosting - Start for Free | Cloudways](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/cloudways): Cloudways: fully managed VPS hosting for WordPress, PHP, and Laravel.
